messages:
sam_marketing: Hey team — quick sync. We had a short degradation this morning affecting some hosted inference requests. Need marketing + CS + ops aligned on the external messaging and timing. Who can help draft status page copy and decide when to push updates?

jordan_eng: here — backend saw elevated GPU OOMs during a burst. Degraded throughput ~09:12–09:35 UTC, root cause a bug in batching logic. Fix deployed 09:30, still verifying. No customer data exposure.

emily_cs: thanks Jordan. CS is getting inbound tickets asking if jobs are re-run. We should include guidance for impacted customers and how to contact us.

sam_marketing: Agreed. Two asks: 1) Status page wording (short/clear), 2) Timing for initial post + follow-up. Also: routing inbound leads -> CS vs sales.

alex_product: For timing I'd suggest: initial status update now (degraded performance, mitigated, investigating cause), follow-up when we have full verification + RCA (ETA 24–48h). If we can confirm full recovery in next hour we can send a "resolved" update sooner.

jordan_eng: we should avoid promising exact ETA until validation finishes. Tentative: follow-up in 6 hours with progress / RCA timeline.

sam_marketing: Draft options for status page copy below. Keep it short; include what happened, scope, user impact, mitigation, next steps. Pick A or B or propose edits.

alex_product: ```Option A (concise):
"Degraded performance — We experienced elevated request latency and reduced throughput for some hosted inference requests between 09:12 and 09:35 UTC. A fix was deployed and we are validating recovery. No customer data was exposed. We will post another update once verification completes."

Option B (more explicit):
"Partial outage affecting request throughput — For approximately 23 minutes we observed failures and slower responses for a subset of hosted inference requests. Engineers have deployed a fix and systems are returning to normal. If you are continuing to see errors, please contact support with request IDs. We will provide a follow-up with root cause and remediation steps within 24–48 hours."```

emily_cs: Option A is cleaner for the initial post. Add a line with how customers reach us: contact/support@redwood.com or open Intercom -> tag `incident`. Also ask customers not to re-run large batches until we confirm recovery to avoid duplicate charges.

sam_marketing: OK — final initial text suggestion (combining A + emily):

"Degraded performance — We experienced elevated request latency and reduced throughput for some hosted inference requests between 09:12 and 09:35 UTC. A fix was deployed and we are validating recovery. No customer data was exposed. If you continue to see errors, contact support@redwood.com or open Intercom and tag `incident`. Please avoid re-running large batches until we confirm full recovery. We will provide a follow-up with root cause and remediation steps within 24–48 hours."

maria_ops: Process note: ops can post to status.redwood.ai once marketing approves copy. Posting path: draft -> staging preview -> publish. If CS needs canned replies, I can push a template to Intercom.

jordan_eng: Also recommend including a note about fallbacks: "If you rely on Dedicated/Private, no impact reported" — confirm with infra team first.

sam_marketing: Good call. Jordan can you confirm Dedicated/Private status so we don't inadvertently alarm on-prem customers?

jordan_eng: Confirmed: Dedicated and Private not impacted. I'll DM infra and paste confirmation once I have it.

emily_cs: For inbound routing: we should auto-tag tickets created in the window as `incident-morning-09-12`. Sales should get an automatic FYI for any enterprise customer (account tier >= Enterprise) with a dedicated owner. CS will triage high-priority accounts and loop in AE.

maria_ops: I'll set that up: Intercom rule to tag messages with subject matching "error" OR created between 1769456720–1769458000 and add `incident-morning-09-12`. Also create canned responses: short customer-safe explanation + escalation checkbox.

sam_marketing: Great. Who will publish the initial status update?

maria_ops: Ops will publish after marketing sign-off. I can do it in 5–10 mins.

sam_marketing: I'll run a quick grammar/tone pass and approve. One more thing: do we want a short tweet/LinkedIn note or keep it to status page + email?

emily_cs: Recommend status page + targeted email to impacted accounts only. Avoid public social unless major outage.

alex_product: Agree. Only escalate to social if incident broadens.

alerts_bot: Incident created INC-2026-03-12-0920 — severity: S2 (degraded performance). Reporter: jordan_eng.

sam_marketing: Awesome. Action items: @alex_product finalize initial text (done), @maria_ops prepare Intercom tag + canned replies (in progress), @jordan_eng confirm Dedicated/Private unaffected (in progress), @emily_cs prep email template for impacted customers (waiting on final list). I'll post approved status copy in 5.

emily_cs: I'll also draft the enterprise email with a placeholder for affected request IDs and impacted regions.

sam_marketing: Approved final status copy posted to #ops-drafts: 

"Degraded performance — We experienced elevated request latency and reduced throughput for some hosted inference requests between 09:12 and 09:35 UTC. A fix was deployed and we are validating recovery. No customer data was exposed. If you continue to see errors, contact support@redwood.com or open Intercom and tag `incident`. Please avoid re-running large batches until we confirm full recovery. We will provide a follow-up with root cause and remediation steps within 24–48 hours." :white_check_mark:

maria_ops: Published to status.redwood.ai — status page shows 'degraded performance' and initial post timestamped 09:45 UTC. Intercom rule queued.

jordan_eng: Infra confirmation: Dedicated/Private unaffected. Copy updated to include that line.

emily_cs: Email draft ready, will send targeted list once engineering confirms the impacted customer list.

sam_marketing: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene for the RCA thread when engineering has full postmortem. If anything changes, ping #marketing-urgent.

maria_ops: Noted — closing this thread after RCA.
